The Clinical Nurse Educator manages, designs, plans, and coordinates clinical education programs for the Heart & Vascular Center (HVC) clinical staff. The Clinical Nurse Educator participates in setting objectives for assigned programs in alignment with organizational strategic plan and identified program opportunities. This includes participation in developing short- and long-term education strategies in collaboration with Center for Professional Practice of Nursing (CPPN) leadership and senior management including identifying training needs, competency requirements, and initiatives to improve the delivery of service. The Clinical Nurse Educator provides leadership in assigned programs through identification of specific learning outcomes, leading innovative educational design, identifying and leading adjunct faculty as appropriate for the educational program, and providing oversight and guidance to administrative staff to ensure record keeping meets needs of all stakeholders, including accrediting bodies as applicable. The Clinical Nurse Educator monitors and ensures compliance with regulations for assigned programs, including adherence to policy, training and leadership of adjunct faculty, policy development, and maintenance of records. The Clinical Nurse Educator assumes fiscal responsibility through active participation in the preparation of budgets for assigned programs/courses, identification of needed resources, including both physical resources, equipment, space, and technology and personnel resources, including need for faculty and technical support.

35% - Program Leader: Leadership for assigned professional development programs to ensure compliance with regulations and standards identified by accreditation body and achievement of identified organizational goals.
35% - Learning Facilitator: Educational program planning, development, implementation and evaluation
20% - Change Management: Support ongoing organizational initiatives through acting as a change agent.
10% - Professional Practice/ Mentorship
Demonstrate proficiency in educational technology use

Ability to adapt to change in a positive, professional and productive manner

Knowledge of performance improvement and evidence-based practice
Knowledge of and ability to plan, implement, and evaluate the educational process, including adult theories of education in clinical, lecture, and technology assisted forums
